task.title: Create a Lightwell Network service account
task.shortdesc: Create a registry service account to authenticate your build tools with the Lightwell Network.

ul.li: You have a Red Hat account associated with your Lightwell Network membership.

step.cmd: Navigate to the Registry Service Account Management Application at Registry Service Accounts and log in with your Red Hat credentials.
Enter a name and description for the service account, and click Create.
Click the service account you created to view its credentials.

substep.cmd: Username: The full string including the prepended portion, in the format XXXXXXX|service-account-name.
Password/Token:The token displayed on the service account detail page.

step.cmd: Store these credentials securely. You will use them to configure authentication in your build tool or artifact repository manager.
